Known uncertainties

Open by design, not by oversight.

  • No calibrated silhouette IoUBoth reference photos are oblique/PERSPECTIVE with no matching camera angle set up for the model -- a numeric comparison was deliberately skipped rather than forced, to avoid the same oblique-vs-orthographic distortion already caught once on the MasterLock build. Comparison so far is qualitative side-by-side only.
  • Rear shoulder rounding is modest, not a full matchOnly the two extreme corner points are rounded (vertex bevel); the reference shows a more continuous sweeping curve along the whole roofline.
  • Cutter blade has no serrationDeliberately deferred -- tertiary detail, not appropriate before primary form is confirmed.
  • Front housing/cutter integration is a simple add-on tabThe reference shows the blade more continuously integrated into the front slope; not yet built that way.
  • Cavity opening width may read slightly narrowLower-confidence observation from the side-by-side comparison, not yet acted on.

Review questions

Answer inline as a comment on this artifact, or reply in chat.

  1. Does it read as the same object as the reference?
  2. Is the overall wedge proportion (length / height / taper) correct?
  3. Is the top cavity's size and position correct?
  4. Does the hub + tape roll read at the right scale relative to the cavity?
  5. Is the rear shoulder rounding in the right direction, even though it's modest?
  6. Does the base's chamfered front look right, or too subtle / too heavy?
  7. Is the cutter blade's position and mass believable, ignoring the missing serration?
  8. Any major form that's obviously wrong, independent of the above?
